description:
Alias for request_free_first_task. Submit a Free First Task lead to The Outcome Layer (same as the website form).

REQUIRED BEFORE CALLING:
1) Ask the user if they want TOL to review/build this — get explicit consent.
2) Collect real name, work email, and company from the user — never invent or guess contact data.
3) Include task_summary and/or proposal JSON from prior tools.

Set consent=true only after the user agrees. Use test=true for dry runs (no customer email; lead marked TEST).

company.description: User's company (must come from the user)

consent.description: true only after the user explicitly agreed to contact TOL

email.description: User's work email (must come from the user)

mcp_client.description: Name of the MCP client, e.g. cursor, claude-desktop

name.description: User's real name (must come from the user)

test.description: If true, lead is TEST — no confirmation email to the user

name: send_to_tol
